name: web-clean-two-column-grocery-checkout
title: Two-Column Grocery Checkout Page
whatItIs: A checkout screen with a teal rounded header, a left column of cards for delivery information and items grouped by store, and a right column with payment options, promo field, itemized totals, an outlined Klarna button and a lime Confirm order button.
whatItMeans: Soft white cards on pale gray keep a dense task calm and ordered, and the lime CTA marks the final step.
techniques: Two-column split with tasks left and summary right
Cards grouped by vendor with collapsible sections
Right-aligned totals with a bold final line
Promo field with an attached dark Apply button
Muted unselected radio options to focus the selected one

vocabulary.definition: A panel listing costs, fees and total.
Cart items organized under their seller.
A full-width rounded button for the final step.
